decision.reason: [ev-d9673d74f883] is only a pre-upgrade checklist item: it says to make sure no `v1alpha1` resources are in use and to check manifests and tooling by hand. It does not name the API group or the kinds whose v1alpha1 version is affected, so no applicability predicate can be written without inventing those identities. It also does not say what changed (for example, whether v1alpha1 was removed or stopped being served) or what happens if v1alpha1 resources remain. We need the release-note or CRD-diff evidence that says which group/kinds lose v1alpha1 in 0.16.0 and how.
